Changelog

gpxtoolbox (development version)

New features

  • Added read_track() as a unified interface that dispatches to read_gpx_track() or read_fit_track() based on file extension.
  • Added read_fit_track() for reading GPS tracks from Garmin FIT files (requires the FITfileR package, installed from GitHub).
  • Added analyse_track(), a file-format-agnostic version of analyse_gpx(). analyse_gpx() now delegates to it.
  • Added identify_geo() for reverse geocoding key track points.
  • Added leaflet markers to plot_route() map visualisations.
  • Added unit tests and a test-coverage CI workflow (covr + Codecov).

Bug fixes

  • Elevation gain no longer over-estimates by double-counting trackpoints with identical coordinates.
  • calculate_elevation_stats() handles tracks without elevation data (NA stats instead of -Inf/Inf) and 0-row input.
  • calculate_route_stats() returns NA_real_ for average speed when the track duration is zero, and guards small-track index calculations.
  • read_fit_track() supports current FITfileR releases (S4 FitFile object, chunked record messages), avoids double-converting coordinates from semicircles, discards invalid out-of-range position sentinels, and accepts both POSIXct and numeric timestamps.
  • analyse_track() cleans up temporary files downloaded from URLs even when an error occurs.
  • plot_route() no longer errors when elevation data is missing from the leaflet popups.
